title: Smart Process & Data Automation
subtitle: Process automation & integration system for client/employer
description: Development of tailored internal tools, REST API integrations, and automated workflows to streamline mission-critical business processes.
longDescription: During this engagement for an employer, a modern integration platform was developed to automate manual and repetitive tasks. The solution connects internal databases with external services, validates data streams, and provides team members with a real-time dashboard for status monitoring and logs. Strong emphasis was placed on robust error handling, high availability, and modern architecture using C# .NET and React.
highlights: Automated time-consuming manual processes, saving over 40% of working hours per week
Built fault-tolerant REST API integrations with structured logging and monitoring
Created a modern, responsive dashboard in React with Tailwind CSS for operations personnel
Designed optimized SQL queries and data models for rapid data access

title: Customer Portal & Case Management System
subtitle: Web-based portal for customer interaction and case management
description: Development of a secure, user-friendly portal for issue tracking, document uploads, and real-time status monitoring.
longDescription: Development of a centralized issue and communication platform designed to simplify interactions between external clients and internal case managers. The system features role-based access control, real-time status notifications, and a responsive interface tailored for both desktop and mobile devices.
highlights: Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) and protected views
Built a clean case overview interface with filtering, search, and status indicators
Optimized frontend performance and UI responsiveness with Tailwind CSS and React
Structured a modular codebase for seamless future enhancements and maintenance
